candidates.source_name: NBS – Materiály NBS v pripomienkovom konaní (NBS materials in comment procedure)
candidates.why_relevant: Central register of NBS draft measures (opatrenia) currently open for comments, listing the slov-lex LP number, publication date and comment deadline in a table (e.g. LP/2026/421 banking reporting amendment, deadline 25.8.2026; LP/2026/437 register of financial agents, deadline 8.9.2026). This is the single earliest, most actionable structured feed of NBS regulatory deadlines for the SK banking/payments sector.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled HTML table scrape (daily/weekly), diff on LP number + deadline; follow each row to slov-lex LP page for documents
queries_used: NBS konzultácia návrh opatrenia pripomienky termín Národná banka Slovenska

candidates.source_name: NBS – Konzultačné materiály (consultation materials, financial consumer protection)
candidates.why_relevant: NBS supervisory-department consultation papers addressed to the professional public, each with an explicit submission deadline (e.g. 'Posudzovanie schopnosti spotrebiteľa splácať úver', published 2.10.2025, deadline 7.11.2025). Signals supervisory expectations before they harden into measures. Low volume but very high signal; long gaps between entries (2015 then 2025).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly scrape of the listing table + PDF download of each consultation paper
queries_used: NBS konzultácia návrh opatrenia pripomienky termín Národná banka Slovenska

candidates.source_name: SLOV-LEX – Legislatívne procesy (inter-ministerial comment procedure, MPK)
candidates.why_relevant: The statutory national portal where every MF SR and NBS draft law/measure enters medzirezortné pripomienkové konanie with an LP/{year}/{number} identifier, full document set, start and end date of the comment period, and all submitted comments (including bank and SBA comments) with the submitter's identity. The authoritative primary record for consultation deadlines and who is lobbying what.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Headless browser rendering (pages require JS) or an LP-number-driven crawl of /elegislativa/legislativne-procesy/SK/LP/{year}/{n}; filter by predkladateľ = MF SR / NBS
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search, snowballed from NBS pripomienkové konanie page
queries_used: slov-lex.sk LP/2025 medzirezortné pripomienkové konanie platobné služby zákon
Ministerstvo financií SR pripomienkové konanie zákon o bankách slov-lex
candidates.observed_blocker: Search snippets report 'JavaScript required' on direct LP pages; treat as bot-unfriendly-but-live, not dead

candidates.source_name: SLOV-LEX – Predbežná informácia (pre-legislative early notice)
candidates.why_relevant: Earliest possible signal in the SK pipeline: ministries must publish a 'predbežná informácia' about a planned law with a short (typically ~15-day) window for suggestions, months before the draft text and MPK. For banking/payments this reveals intent to transpose EU acts (PSD3/PSR, MiCA-related, CRD/CRR) before any text exists.
candidates.access_status: open, sortable listing with query params
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the sortable listing (orderByCol=datumZaciatkuMPKAleboVytvoreniaProcesu&orderByType=desc) daily; filter rows where predkladateľ is MF SR or NBS
queries_used: NBS vestník opatrenia MPK "predbežná informácia" slov-lex Ministerstvo financií finančný trh 2026

candidates.source_name: NBS – Aktuality / MPK announcement news items
candidates.why_relevant: NBS announces the start of each MPK as a dated news item naming the draft measure and the comment-period end date (observed: 'Informácia o začatí MPK – opatrenie NBS o predkladaní výkazov poskytovateľmi služieb kryptoaktív', MPK 10.1.2025–30.1.2025, proposed effectiveness 1.7.2025). Useful as a push-style alerting layer over the register.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the aktuality listing; keyword filter on 'MPK', 'pripomienkové konanie', 'konzultácia', 'opatrenie'
queries_used: NBS vestník opatrenia MPK "predbežná informácia" slov-lex Ministerstvo financií finančný trh 2026

candidates.source_name: NBS – Vestník NBS (official journal, yearly issues)
candidates.why_relevant: Terminal end of the consultation pipeline: the issued measure with its number and effective date (účinnosť), which is the compliance deadline banks and PSPs must hit. Pairing Vestník entries with the earlier MPK record gives measured lead time from consultation to compliance.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Yearly index scrape plus per-document detail fetch; extract measure number, date, effective date
queries_used: NBS konzultácia návrh opatrenia pripomienky termín Národná banka Slovenska

candidates.source_name: NBS – Legislatíva / detail dokumentu (measures repository, dohľad nad finančným trhom)
candidates.why_relevant: Per-measure detail pages for adopted opatrenia (e.g. opatrenie 6/2025 on reporting consumer-credit data; opatrenie 7/2024 amending 4/2015 on risk-management systems). Gives the canonical text and dates a consultation ended in, and the reference numbers to link back to LP entries.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Index crawl of the legislation listing; store detail-document URLs and effective dates
queries_used: NBS konzultácia návrh opatrenia pripomienky termín Národná banka Slovenska

candidates.source_name: NBS – Metodické usmernenia, stanoviská a odporúčania
candidates.why_relevant: Soft-law layer (methodological guidance, opinions, recommendations) that often follows a consultation and carries de-facto compliance dates without being a formal measure. Frequently the concrete supervisory expectation a bank must implement.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic listing scrape + PDF capture
queries_used: NBS konzultácia návrh opatrenia pripomienky termín Národná banka Slovenska

candidates.source_name: NBS mailing list / notification subscription
candidates.why_relevant: Official push channel for NBS publications; the consultation pages offer no dedicated RSS, so email subscription is the sanctioned low-latency alerting mechanism for new consultation and measure notices.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Subscribe a monitored mailbox; parse inbound notification emails into the deadline tracker
queries_used: NBS konzultácia návrh opatrenia pripomienky termín Národná banka Slovenska

candidates.source_name: MF SR – Finančný trh (financial market policy hub)
candidates.why_relevant: Ministry of Finance owner-page for banking & payment services, capital market, insurance, intermediation, consumer protection and international sanctions, each split into 'Legislatíva' and 'Európska agenda'. The European-agenda subsections are where transposition intentions and EU-file positions surface before national drafts.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Section crawl of bankovníctvo/platobné služby and Európska agenda subpages; diff on new documents
queries_used: mfsr.sk "verejná konzultácia" konzultačný materiál finančný trh Ministerstvo financií

candidates.source_name: MF SR / fininfo.sk – Bankovníctvo legislation section
candidates.why_relevant: MF SR's financial-information portal listing banking legislation in force and links to amendments; useful as a cross-check that a consulted draft has actually become law and on what date.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl; use as reference cross-check rather than alerting
queries_used: Ministerstvo financií SR pripomienkové konanie zákon o bankách slov-lex

candidates.source_name: MF SR – Tlačové správy (press releases on draft measures)
candidates.why_relevant: MF SR announces intended banking measures here often before or alongside MPK (observed: 'Návrh opatrení na ochranu klientov bánk' — proposal to increase bank price transparency and client protection). Gives political framing and intended timing that the legal text omits.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll press-release listing; keyword filter 'banky', 'platobné služby', 'pripomienkové konanie', 'novela'
queries_used: Ministerstvo financií SR pripomienkové konanie zákon o bankách slov-lex

candidates.source_name: NR SR – parliamentary bill tracking (Národná rada SR)
candidates.why_relevant: After MPK, the draft goes to parliament where the dôvodová správa (explanatory memorandum), committee amendments and the final effective date are decided — the stage where compliance deadlines most often shift. Document previews (DocID-addressed) carry the explanatory memoranda that state transposition deadlines explicitly.
candidates.access_status: open, legacy ASPX with query-string document IDs
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the parliamentary print (CPT) listing per term; fetch DocumentPreview.aspx?DocID= for dôvodová správa text
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search, snowballed from law-amendment results
queries_used: NRSR parlament sledovanie zákonov finančný trh "zákon o platobných službách" novela 2026
Ministerstvo financií SR pripomienkové konanie zákon o bankách slov-lex

candidates.source_name: Rokovania vlády SR – government meeting materials portal
candidates.why_relevant: The stage between MPK and parliament: government session agendas and the full submitted material, including the vyhodnotenie pripomienok (evaluation of comments) showing which industry objections were accepted. Accessible without login.
candidates.access_status: open, no login required for viewing
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll session agendas; download material bundles for MF SR/NBS items; parse vyhodnotenie pripomienok tables
queries_used: rokovania.gov.sk rokovania vlády SR materiál zákon finančný trh legislatíva portal

candidates.source_name: Legislatívna rada vlády SR (LRV) – rokovania
candidates.why_relevant: The Government Legislative Council reviews drafts post-MPK; its agendas reveal which financial-market bills are moving and when, a scheduling signal ahead of the government session.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Agenda listing scrape, keyword filter on banking/payment law titles
queries_used: rokovania.gov.sk rokovania vlády SR materiál zákon finančný trh legislatíva portal

candidates.source_name: LexAPI (Essential Data) – commercial legislative-monitoring REST API
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial REST API aggregating legislative processes from both Slov-Lex and NR SR with attribute filtering and change feeds. Solves the JS-rendering and polling problems of Slov-Lex; the pragmatic backbone for an automated deadline tracker if licensing is acceptable.
candidates.legal_status: commercial licence — do not scrape, contract instead
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Evaluate paid API subscription; pull filtered feed for MF SR / NBS submitters
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search for open data / API
queries_used: slov-lex API otvorené dáta legislatívne procesy RSS predbežná informácia

candidates.source_name: LexEPI – Legislatívne procesy (Slov-Lex) commercial tracker
candidates.why_relevant: EPI (Poradca podnikateľa) mirrors and indexes Slov-Lex legislative processes with editorial summaries; useful as a second, more scrape-friendly view and to catch items whose titles are opaque on the primary portal.
candidates.legal_status: commercial publisher — respect ToS, limited excerpting only
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/low-volume reference use; subscription if depth is needed
queries_used: slov-lex API otvorené dáta legislatívne procesy RSS predbežná informácia
candidates.observed_blocker: Publisher site, likely subscription-gated beyond listings

candidates.source_name: legalis.sk – Medzirezortné pripomienkové konanie digest
candidates.why_relevant: Law-firm/legal-media digest of ongoing MPK items with commentary; a cheap human-curated filter that flags which consultations the SK legal market considers material, and often summarises deadlines in plain language.
candidates.legal_status: third-party editorial — cite, do not republish
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic listing poll, headline capture with link-out to primary LP record
queries_used: slov-lex.sk LP/2025 medzirezortné pripomienkové konanie platobné služby zákon

candidates.source_name: Slovenská banková asociácia (SBA) – novinky a tlačové správy
candidates.why_relevant: The only association representing SK banks; it files hromadné pripomienky in MPK and publicises its positions. Reveals industry objections and the practical implementation burden of a draft — the counter-party view to the regulator's, and a leading indicator of which deadlines will slip.
candidates.legal_status: private association — public web content, cite with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll novinky + tlačové správy categories; cross-link to SBA comments filed on slov-lex LP records
queries_used: Slovenská banková asociácia pripomienky legislatíva stanoviská SBA sbaonline.sk

candidates.source_name: SLOV-LEX – hromadné pripomienky (mass/collective comments) sub-register
candidates.why_relevant: Sub-view of the comment register showing collective/mass comments, which trigger mandatory rozporové konanie (dispute resolution meeting) and therefore predictably delay a measure. High-value early warning that a deadline will move.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Headless-browser fetch of the /pripomienky/ and /hromadne-pripomienky/ paths per tracked LP number
candidates.discovered_via_method: search result snowball from slov-lex LP query
queries_used: slov-lex.sk LP/2025 medzirezortné pripomienkové konanie platobné služby zákon
candidates.observed_blocker: Slov-Lex front-end requires JS; unverified via plain fetch

candidates.source_name: MF SR – Finančné inovácie / regulatory sandbox consultation track
candidates.why_relevant: MF SR's Centrum finančných inovácií with NBS ran an explicit consultation paper on sandbox design to collect market feedback; this track is where fintech/payments-specific SK consultations appear outside the standard MPK channel.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl of the finančné inovácie subtree; capture consultation PDFs
queries_used: mfsr.sk "verejná konzultácia" konzultačný materiál finančný trh Ministerstvo financií

candidates.source_name: NBS English-language supervision/legislation mirror
candidates.why_relevant: English mirror of NBS legislation/decree pages (observed for Decree 8/2022). Useful for cross-lingual entity matching and for analysts without Slovak, but coverage of live consultations is thinner than the SK tree — treat SK as canonical.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch EN counterpart URL where a SK document has one; use for translation cross-check only

candidates.why_relevant: Consolidated, date-versioned texts of zákon č. 483/2001 Z. z. o bankách and zákon č. 492/2009 Z. z. o platobných službách, with per-version effective dates (e.g. payment services act versions effective 17.1.2025, 8.4.2025, and a change effective 1.5.2026). Lets a consultation be tied to the exact compliance date it produced.

candidates.why_relevant: Third-party mirrors of SK acts that expose clean version timelines and future effective dates (autora.sk surfaced the 1.5.2026 change to the Payment Services Act). Far easier to parse than the official portal; use as a discovery aid, always confirming against Slov-Lex.

negative_findings.description: Neither the NBS 'Konzultačné materiály' page nor the 'Materiály NBS v pripomienkovom konaní' page exposes an RSS/Atom feed or a consultation-specific subscription; only a general site-wide mailing list at https://nbs.sk/mailing-list/ was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: No machine-readable push channel for NBS consultations; polling or email parsing is required.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Deadline monitoring must be built on scheduled scraping, which raises staleness and breakage risk for the highest-priority sources in this cell.

negative_findings.description: Direct slov-lex.sk legislative-process and comment URLs returned 'JavaScript required' via plain search/fetch. This is a rendering limitation, not evidence the pages are dead.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slov-Lex LP pages unverified by plain fetch; treated as live-but-JS-gated hypothesis.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most authoritative consultation-deadline register in this cell needs headless-browser collection or a commercial API (LexAPI), which changes cost and architecture.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, standing 'verejná konzultácia' hub page for financial-market topics was found on mfsr.sk; MF SR consultation activity appears episodically as press releases, programme pages (finančné inovácie/sandbox) and via slov-lex predbežná informácia / MPK.
negative_findings.result_summary: MF SR consultations are distributed across channels rather than centralised.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A single-page monitor of MF SR would miss consultations; the collector must watch slov-lex, MF SR press releases and topic subtrees in parallel.

negative_findings.description: The NBS 'Konzultačné materiály' listing showed only three entries in total, two from 2015 and one from 2025 — a decade-long gap.
negative_findings.result_summary: NBS formal consultation-paper volume is very low; most real activity flows through MPK on slov-lex.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ranking sources by name alone would over-weight the consultation page; MPK/slov-lex is where the recurring signal actually is.

negative_findings.description: English-language searching surfaced far fewer live consultation artefacts than Slovak searching; NBS English pages mostly mirror already-issued decrees rather than open comment periods.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-only monitoring of this cell would miss most open comment periods and all MPK deadlines.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms local-language collection is mandatory, not optional, for the consultations/deadlines workstream in SK.

coverage_gaps.description: Several candidates (slov-lex LP pages, lrv.rokovania.sk, fininfo.sk, mfsr.sk subtrees) were identified from search results and not confirmed by successful direct fetch in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness/verification pass with a JS-capable fetcher and realistic user agent before scoring these as dead.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-level consultation feeds that drive SK transposition deadlines (EBA, ECB/SSM, EU Commission 'Have your say', EPC for payments) were out of this cell's national scope and were not scouted here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ensure another cell or a follow-up run covers EU-level consultation calendars and maps them to SK transposition deadlines.

coverage_gaps.description: No structured extraction path was established for 'vyhodnotenie pripomienok' (comment-evaluation tables) which state which objections were accepted and whether the effective date moved.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Design a parser for the DOCX/PDF comment-evaluation attachments on rokovania.gov.sk and slov-lex LP records.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-bank payments actors that also file comments (fintech/e-money associations, SK Fintech association, consumer bodies) were not mapped; only the bank association (SBA) was captured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snowball comment submitters listed on 2-3 recent payments-related LP records to build a full stakeholder actor map.

coverage_gaps.description: LexAPI and LexEPI commercial terms, pricing and redistribution rights were not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Request commercial terms from Essential Data (LexAPI) and evaluate against the cost of maintaining an in-house headless scraper for Slov-Lex.

brief: Slovakia's consultation and deadline signal for banking and payments is highly centralised in the state legislative pipeline rather than in regulator-branded consultation portals: SLOV-LEX carries the statutory predbežná informácia (earliest intent), the medzirezortné pripomienkové konanie with an LP/{year}/{n} identifier, dated comment window and the full text of every submitted comment, then rokovania.gov.sk and NR SR carry the comment-evaluation and the final effective date. NBS mirrors its own drafts on a compact table page with LP numbers and deadlines (observed LP/2026/421 and LP/2026/437) and announces each MPK start in aktuality, while its separate Konzultačné materiály series is high-signal but very low volume. MF SR has no standing financial-market consultation hub; its activity surfaces through slov-lex, press releases and topic programme pages such as finančné inovácie/sandbox. The main engineering constraint is that Slov-Lex is JavaScript-rendered and no source in this cell offers RSS, so reliable deadline tracking needs headless-browser polling of Slov-Lex plus the NBS tables, optionally shortcut through the commercial LexAPI aggregator; local-language terms (pripomienkové konanie, MPK, predbežná informácia, opatrenie, účinnosť) are indispensable, as English-only searching surfaced almost no open comment periods.
